title: Determinant of order 2
back: Main diagonal product minus the other diagonal product. Only square matrices have determinants.

title: Minor and cofactor
legend: M_{ij} = determinant left after deleting row i and column j
back: Signs follow a chessboard starting with +. $\lvert A\rvert$ = sum of (elements of any row or column × their own cofactors).

title: Determinant of kA
back: Order 3: $\lvert 2A\rvert=8\lvert A\rvert$. The most common 1-mark slip is writing $2\lvert A\rvert$.

title: Area of a triangle
back: Area is positive: take the absolute value. If the area is given, use both signs ($\pm$) to find $k$. Zero area means collinear points.

title: The adjoint identity
back: So $\lvert\operatorname{adj}A\rvert=\lvert A\rvert^{n-1}$: for order 3 it is $\lvert A\rvert^2$.

title: Adjoint of a 2 × 2 matrix
back: Swap the diagonal, change the signs of the other two. For order 3: matrix of cofactors, then transpose.

title: Inverse of a matrix
back: Singular matrix ($\lvert A\rvert=0$): no inverse. $\lvert A^{-1}\rvert=\dfrac{1}{\lvert A\rvert}$.

title: Matrix method
back: Unique solution when $\lvert A\rvert\ne0$. Write the product as $A^{-1}B$, never $BA^{-1}$.

title: When |A| = 0
back: If $(\operatorname{adj}A)B=O$: infinitely many solutions or none. Consistent means at least one solution.

title: Using a given product
back: In "find $AB$ and hence solve" questions, the product gives the inverse for free. If the system uses $A'$, use $(A')^{-1}=(A^{-1})'$.
